messages:
jamal_sales: Heads-up team - Stellaris Health gave the green light for a 2-week POC but loaded a long identity/security checklist. Key asks: SAML SSO, SCIM delta provisioning, group-based RBAC, delegated tenant admins, domain ownership proof, EU data residency for PHI, and pricing split hosted vs dedicated.

alex_k: Good. What's their expected user count and provisioning cadence? Any strict SLA asks for provisioning latency?

jamal_sales: They expect ~1k users at kickoff, scaling to ~10k in a year. Typical daily churn will be low but they may do bulk imports and periodic delta syncs. They prefer near-realtime provisioning (<30s) for new hires. Also need delegated admin capability so customer admins can manage users.

maria_product: Quick product notes: hosted supports SAML and SCIM v2 with group membership mapping out of the box. Hosted default rate limit for SCIM is 200 req/min; Dedicated can raise limits and enable webhook-driven provisioning for sub-30s flows. Delegated admin UI and customer-managed KMS are Private/Dedicated features. EU-only residency is available on Dedicated/Private running in eu-west-1/eu-central-1.

olivia_sec: Security side: they sent the standard vendor questionnaire and asked for SOC2 Type II, TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, KMS support, and contractual language around PHI handling. I can pull SOC2 and the redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf and assemble answers in ~48h. Legal may need ~72h for KMS & PHI contract language.

ben_eng: SCIM details to share: we support the Okta delta token flow and bulk endpoints. Hosted default throttle is 200 req/min; Dedicated can be configured to 1k+/min depending on capacity. We map SCIM groups to RBAC roles via the 'groups' attribute. Example user patch payload: 

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jane@stellaris.example",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value":"jane@stellaris.example","primary":true}],
  "groups": [{"value":"engineering","display":"Engineering"}]
}
```

ben_eng: For <30s provisioning we recommend enabling Okta outbound provisioning webhooks or running the POC on Dedicated with increased rate limits and background workers.

jamal_sales: They're also asking for a sample SAML metadata snippet and the exact attribute names we consume for mapping. Can someone paste a minimal template?

alex_k: SAML metadata example to forward:
```
<saml2:EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example.com\">
  <md:SPSSODescriptor>
    <md:AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://app.redwood.example.com/sso/callback\"/>
  </md:SPSSODescriptor>
</saml2:EntityDescriptor>
```
Attributes we expect: `email` (string), `givenName`, `familyName`, `name` (full name), and `groups` (array of strings).

maria_product: Pricing context: hosted includes SCIM up to 5k active identities; above that we charge a provisioning surcharge per additional 1k. Dedicated includes reserved capacity + platform fee; domain lock and delegated admin controls are typically part of Private onboarding (one-time setup + monthly). I'll prepare a ballpark and call out which items push them to Dedicated/Private (KMS, EU residency, delegated admin).

olivia_sec: I'll prepare the security questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 and the redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf. Note: for hosted we cannot provide HSM attestation or customer-controlled KMS; those require Dedicated/Private.

jamal_sales: Stellaris wants answers within 3 business days. Olivia you mentioned 48h for core artifacts - is that doable?

olivia_sec: Yes core artifacts + questionnaire answers in 48h. Anything requiring contract/legal approval (KMS/PHI-specific clauses, data residency proofs) will need ~72h.

maria_product: Action list: 1) Jamal to request their Okta SCIM adapter config, delta token example, and expected provisioning spike rates; 2) Olivia to assemble sec package and SOC2 in 48h and list legal-dependent items; 3) Ben to write a one-page note on provisioning latency options (webhook vs Dedicated rate limits) and SCIM mapping examples; 4) I'll draft a hosted vs dedicated pricing ballpark and call out migration path for POC -> Dedicated.

jamal_sales: They want to include domain verification (domain lock) in the POC. Can we run domain proofing in hosted?

maria_product: Yes domain verification (DNS/TXT or email proof) and basic domain-locking (prevent tenant takeover) are supported in Hosted for the POC. We'll document the steps in the SOW. Delegated admin, customer KMS, and EU-only tenancy require Dedicated/Private.

jamal_sales: Great. I'll confirm the POC scope: SSO, SCIM group sync, domain verification; exclude delegated admin and KMS. I'll request their SCIM config and Okta logs. Tagging @olivia_sec @ben_eng for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

sec_bot: Reminder: attach redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf when responding to security questionnaires — https://internal.redwood.com/sec/redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf

jamal_sales: Sent the sample SAML and SCIM guidance to the customer and attached the sec package link. Will update thread once they return the Okta adapter config and delta logs.
